notes: All 160 Aversi branch coordinates were read from the destination of the directions link published on the exact official branch page. No Google review or photo content was imported.

PSP locations and source image paths are published by the official app.psp.ge public getPharmacies GraphQL query. 365 nationwide records were read in four paginated requests; 184 carry the Tbilisi source city.
Near existing same-brand points without a sufficiently unique identity match are held to prevent duplicate branches.
Explicit settlements Tskneti, Kojori and Shindisi retain their settlement names even when included in the official Tbilisi locator.
Image credits identify the publishing source, not an inferred photographer. No creative-commons license or unknown capture date is fabricated.
